mcp_tools.name: personal_web_presence_audit
mcp_tools.title: Personal web presence audit
mcp_tools.description: Submits a personal web-presence record (hub and spokes, identity facts and structured data, content standards and name SEO, cadence/contact/measurement, red lines) and returns a deterministic PERSONAL_PRESENCE_CONSISTENT / PERSONAL_PRESENCE_INCONSISTENT / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five sections, including computed per-spoke and per-profile consistency checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared presence record; it fetches nothing and verifies no live page.

inputSchema.description: The personal web presence audit manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

person.description: Person whose presence record is audited.

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Computed spot checks: spokes_count=1, profiles_count=1, redirect_coverage=1.000000
